prompt: Operate the Linux VM using only vm_* tools. Take a screenshot, then double-click the Home icon on the desktop (use vm_click with count=2). Wait and take another screenshot to confirm a file manager opened. Do not use bash/read/write/edit tools.

Operate the Linux VM using only vm_* tools. Mousepad is open with /home/aib/aib-edit-test.txt. Take a screenshot, click into the text area, press ctrl+a, then use vm_type_text to enter exactly these three lines with newlines: alpha
new-line
omega
. Press ctrl+s to save. Do not use bash/read/write/edit tools. The file must contain only alpha, new-line, omega in that order.

Operate the Linux VM using only vm_* tools. A browser is showing a local test page. Take a screenshot. Scroll to the bottom of the page until you see BOTTOM MARKER (use vm_scroll with large positive deltaY). Then drag the blue DRAG box to the dashed DROP HERE target using vm_drag with coordinates from a fresh screenshot. The page title must become bottom-and-drag-ok. Do not use bash/read/write/edit tools.
